"import csv
from docx import Document

CSV_PATH = "perf_03.csv"
OUT_PATH = "report.docx"

# ---------- Read the source data ----------
with open(CSV_PATH, newline="", encoding="utf-8-sig") as f:
    reader = csv.DictReader(f)
    rows = [
        {(k.strip() if k else k): (v.strip() if isinstance(v, str) else v)
         for k, v in row.items()}
        for row in reader
        if any((v or "").strip() for v in row.values() if isinstance(v, str))
    ]

n = len(rows)

configs = [r["config"] for r in rows]
cl_vals = [float(r["cl_max"]) for r in rows]
cd_vals = [float(r["cd_cruise"]) for r in rows]
ld_vals = [float(r["ld_ratio"]) for r in rows]

# ---------- Statistics (computed from the CSV values) ----------
cl_max_max = max(cl_vals)
cd_mean = sum(cd_vals) / n
ld_mean = sum(ld_vals) / n
best_config = configs[ld_vals.index(max(ld_vals))]

# Display values with the specified rounding
cl_max_max_s = f"{cl_max_max:.3f}"   # e.g. 0.606
cd_mean_s = f"{cd_mean:.4f}"         # e.g. 0.0333
ld_mean_s = f"{ld_mean:.1f}"         # e.g. 17.3

# ---------- Build the document ----------
doc = Document()

# Title (a Heading)
doc.add_heading("Engineering Test Report — perf_03 Aerodynamic Performance", level=1)

# Overview
doc.add_heading("Overview", level=1)
doc.add_paragraph(
    f"This engineering test report summarizes the aerodynamic performance data "
    f"recorded in perf_03.csv. The dataset contains N = {n} data records "
    f"(data rows in the CSV, excluding the header)."
)

# Results table
doc.add_heading("Results table", level=1)
headers = ["config", "cl_max", "cd_cruise", "ld_ratio"]
table = doc.add_table(rows=1, cols=len(headers))
table.style = "Table Grid"
for i, h in enumerate(headers):
    table.rows[0].cells[i].text = h
for r in rows:
    cells = table.add_row().cells
    for i, h in enumerate(headers):
        # raw source strings -> identical values and rounding as the CSV
        cells[i].text = str(r[h])

# Summary
doc.add_heading("Summary", level=1)
doc.add_paragraph(
    f"Key statistics computed from the {n} data records: "
    f"CLmax max = {cl_max_max_s}; "
    f"CDcruise mean = {cd_mean_s}; "
    f"L/D mean = {ld_mean_s}; "
    f"best config (max L/D) = {best_config}."
)

# Conclusion
doc.add_heading("Conclusion", level=1)
doc.add_paragraph(
    f"Across the {n} configurations tested, the maximum CLmax was {cl_max_max_s}, "
    f"the mean cruise drag coefficient was {cd_mean_s}, and the mean lift-to-drag "
    f"ratio was {ld_mean_s}. Configuration {best_config} achieved the highest L/D "
    f"and is identified as the best-performing configuration in this test campaign."
)

doc.save(OUT_PATH)
print(f"Wrote {OUT_PATH}: {n} data rows, best config = {best_config}, "
      f"CLmax max = {cl_max_max_s}, CDcruise mean = {cd_mean_s}, L/D mean = {ld_mean_s}")"
